MORE:
Dion Global Solutions Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 03/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve 1. To take on record appointment of representative of IIRIS on board of directors of the company.
2. To take on record cessation of earlier directors and Key Management Personnel in pursuance of approval of resolution plan
3. To allot equity share capital to IIRIS in pursuance of approval of resolution plan.
4. To authorise Directors of the company, jointly or severally, to operate bank accounts of company, enter into agreements with vendors and customers, get their credential updated with various regulatory and statutory authorities and to undertake other necessary and incidental activities for smooth functioning of operations of company.
